svg.title: Two ways to start an AI evaluation
svg.desc: A comparison of a product-led start with a Blueprint-led start. The product-led start leads with features, a generic demo, and a trial request. The Blueprint-led start leads with business priorities, real workflows, measured value, and an executive decision.
